The starting pitching split is hard to ignore: Freddy Peralta at 3.72 FIP, Jack Flaherty at 5.29, a 1.57-point advantage that anchors the Mets case. Context worth noting: the Mets' rotation ranks 3rd in the league by FIP, putting this lineup behind one of the better pitching groups in baseball right now. This is one of the cleaner Mets ML spots of the week — the process is pointing in the right direction and the price is workable.
